_comment: Human-name -> API-value taxonomy cache for the update-TI-course-metadata skill. Update this file whenever Celonis Academy adds new tags or custom-field options in the TI admin UI. All UUIDs were captured 2026-07-27 from GET /incoming/v2/tags on the Celonis Academy TI instance.

audience_tags._visibility_warning: Audience tags control catalog visibility. Setting 'internal', 'public', 'customer', 'partner', or 'academic' makes the course immediately visible to everyone in that logged-in group. 'academy' is Academy-only and low-risk. Skill MUST warn and require explicit confirmation before writing visibility-triggering tags.

owner_tags._note: Owner tags do NOT affect visibility. Format: 'Owner <First> <Last>'. Auto-suggest the current LXD's tag; ask if unclear.

ribbon_slugs._note: Valid ribbon slugs discovered via probe error message on 2026-07-27. Display names are the LXD-facing labels in the TI admin UI. Accept either form as input; write the slug.

internal.display: Internal (purpose unclear - confirm with LXD before using)

custom_fields._note: UI label -> API key mapping and enum options. When writing customFields, use the API key, not the UI label.

readonly_via_api._note: Fields that the metadata endpoint does not accept writes for. Instruct the LXD to set these in the TI admin UI.
readonly_via_api.source: Advanced Settings > Source (approximate duration). Every value tested returns HTTP 400 A processing error occurred, including strings other courses already have stored. Possible TI API bug or intentional read-only. Consider feature request.
readonly_via_api.learning_objectives_tab: Detail Page Settings > Tabs > free-text tab called 'Learning Objectives'. No API field found.
